استنفيا (form X)
# اِسْتَنْفَيَا (istanfayā) /is.tan.fa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَنْفَى (istanfā)
# اُسْتُنْفِيَا (ustunfiyā) /us.tun.fi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَنْفَى (istanfā)
# اِسْتَنْفِيَا (istanfiyā) /is.tan.fi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَنْفَى (istanfā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
